fields.english:
Aelthalyste show our people great respect by sending them back to me for more training, and now I do the same for her tribe.

You return to the Undercity, <name>. There, in the War Quarter, she be ready to teach you more 'bout your people and their ways. Go there, and do not wait long.
Speak to Aelthalyste in the Undercity.
Good, you've returned, and not a moment too late. We have great things to discuss, <name>. Your abilities are growing stronger, and we must make sure you are ready.
I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, <name>. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
